headline: Charter Communications to Cut $2 Billion in Costs in Operating Overhaul
summary: Charter Communications announced plans to reduce annualized operating costs by $2 billion over the next 18 months through a fundamental redesign of its operating model. Company shares fell 2.7 per cent in morning trading.
why: Charter Communications is a major American broadband provider and cable operator operating in a highly competitive market.

impacts.name: Charter Communications
impacts.why: Cost-cutting announcements and operational overhauls can create near-term investor uncertainty reflected in stock price drops.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted to the structural overhaul and cost-cutting initiatives aimed at navigating a competitive cable market.
